messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed high eviction rate for g6 spot GPUs in us-west2 this morning, ~18% over the last 3h. Canaries dipped and tail latency spiked. Thinking we need an adaptive bid-threshold + small holdback for critical pools. Anyone else seeing this?
ryan: Yep, perf-tests alerted. Latency bump aligns with preemptions. For critical real-time pools I lean capacity-optimized; keep price-optimized for batch training.
sophie: Agree on split strategy but note capacity-optimized raised costs ~20% last month during peak. What if we do dynamic holdback: 5% reserve for canaries + hot buffer, flip to capacity-optimized only when eviction > 10% for 30m?
kevin: Also worth adding bid-throttling to avoid bidding wars. Current max_bid_pct=100% of on-demand is dangerous. Propose cap at 75% with linear backoff and zone-spread to reduce correlated evictions.
maria: Rough policy sketch: if eviction_rate > threshold -> set bid_strategy=capacity-optimized, holdback=5-10%, max_bid_pct=75, warm_buffer=2 nodes/pool, cross-zone spread. Example config we can test: 
```yaml
pool: realtime-g6
strategy:
  default: price-optimized
  failover_when:
    eviction_rate: 0.10 # 10% sustained
    window: 1800s # 30m
  failover_to: capacity-optimized
holdback: 0.05 # 5% capacity reserved for canaries
max_bid_pct: 0.75
warm_buffer: 2
cross_region_fallback: eu-west1 # only for critical pools
```
laura: Cross-region fallback is good for availability, but watch egress + latency impact. Maybe only failover to eu-west1 for stateful canaries, not full traffic.
ops-bot: perf-tests: applied rolling scaling policy to realtime-g6 at 2026-03-17T22:10Z; monitoring window started.
ryan: Add a metric to track cost delta vs baseline weekly so SRE/product can evaluate tradeoffs. Also set canary failover TTL to 10m before full region failover.
sophie: I'll run 48h simulation with historical spot traces (us-west2 zones) and compare three knobs: holdback (0/5/10%), bid-cap (65/75/90%), and fast failover vs slow. Will post results tomorrow.
kevin: SGTM. I'll open a TF PR to add the new fields (holdback, max_bid_pct, failover_when) and a small job to stagger bids across zones. Tagging @oncall for visibility.
maria: Thanks — plan: pilot tonight at 22:00 PT on prod-sandbox realtime-g6 pool with holdback=5% and max_bid_pct=75. If evictions drop <8% in 2h we expand.
laura: FYI I'll monitor latency dashboards + cost alerts.
kevin: ETA for PR: 2h.
sophie: Simulation started. Will ping channel with numbers once done. :eyes:
maria: Nice — appreciate the quick turnaround. If pilot looks good we can template this for other critical pools and add a rollout playbook.
